description: This file defines a PHP class WorkflowStateModel which implements the Normalizable interface. The class encapsulates a WorkflowStateMachine entity and provides a method to convert it to an array suitable for serialization, including properties 'action' and 'name'. It is part of the API version 2 module of the OrangeHRM system, representing a model for workflow state data.

classes.name: WorkflowStateModel
classes.description: A model class representing the workflow state for API serialization, wrapping a WorkflowStateMachine entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a WorkflowStateMachine entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the workflow state model into an associative array with 'action' and 'name' keys for serialization.
